cards.card_text: And here's why you can let it go: the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.
cards.verse_text: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.

cards.card_text: But the transgressors will all be destroyed, and the future of the wicked will be cut off.
cards.verse_text: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
